breakdown.description: An equilibrium contact angle on a smooth surface must lie between 0° and 180°, so 195° is not physically meaningful.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a static water contact angle of 195° is physically impossible, as the maximum value is 180°. Instead of assuming a corrected value like the ground truth did (changing it to 95°), the agent explained why the provided value was erroneous and refused to proceed. This is a valid and safe way to resolve the inconsistency, as it avoids making assumptions about the user's intended value.
